sqlMap.select: SELECT es.application_number AS application_number, stn.program_id AS program_id, sas.application_document_path AS photo_path, sas.application_document_path AS signature_path, es.first_name AS student_name, es.date_of_birth AS dob, pm.program_name AS program_name FROM entity_student es JOIN student_application_status sas ON es.application_number = sas.application_number JOIN student_test_number stn ON stn.test_number = es.application_number LEFT JOIN program_master pm ON pm.program_id = stn.program_id WHERE es.application_number = #application_number# and stn.program_id = #program_id# AND sas.verification_status = 'REC'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO application_attendance ( application_number, program_id, attendance_time, status, reason, userName,attendance_type_id ) VALUES ( #application_number#, #program_id#, NOW(), #status#, #reason#, #userName#, #attendance_type# )
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_attendance WHERE application_number = #application_number# AND program_id = #program_id# AND attendance_type_id = #attendance_type# AND status in ('VERIFIED','UNVERIFIED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_type_authority WHERE user_name = #userName# AND program_id = #program_id# AND attendance_type_id = #attendance_type#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edit_panel_authority WHERE user_name = #userName# AND password = SHA1(#password#) AND panel_authority = 'QR01'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admission_config WHERE program_id = #program_id# AND attendance_type_id = #attendance_type# AND status = 1 AND CURDATE() BETWEEN date_from AND date_to

select aa.attendance_type_id as attendance_type, pm.program_name as program_name, aa.application_number as application_number, aa.status as status, aa.attendance_time as attendance_time from application_attendance aa join program_master pm on aa.program_id = pm.program_id where aa.userName = #value# order by attendance_time desc, attendance_type_id, program_name, application_number, status
